milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The granite corridor walls span (~-1,~0,~2) to (~4,~3,~5) with target at center (1,1,4). max_distance=3 ensures the player has physically walked into the granite corridor (not just standing at spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at the granite walls.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The brick corridor walls span (~-1,~0,~6) to (~6,~3,~10) with target at center (2,1,8). max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the brick corridor section, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking toward the brick walls.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The magenta wall banner is mounted on the brick wall at (~0,~1,~9). max_distance=4 ensures the player is close enough to clearly observe the banner, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The orange standing banner is at (~5,~0,~14) in the final oak plank chamber. max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated through all previous sections and entered the final chamber, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at the banner.
